title: Partial weight one modularity for Galois representations associated to mod $p$ Hilbert modular forms
summary: Let $p$ be an odd prime. Let $ρ: G_F \to \mathrm{GL}_2(\overline{\mathbb{F}}_p)$ be a Galois representation of a totally real field $F$. For a small partial weight one weight $(k,0)$, we prove that modularity of $ρ$ can be characterised using $p$-adic Hodge theory, as conjectured by Diamond and Sasaki. We show that if $ρ$ is modular with respect to a partial weight one mod $p$ Hilbert modular form, then each of its local representations has a crystalline lift with prescribed Hodge--Tate weights.
